summary: Important: rust-rpm-sequoia security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
An implementation of the RPM PGP interface using Sequoia.

Security Fix(es):

* sequoia-openpgp: sequoia-openpgp: Cryptographic integrity compromise via key flag confusion (CVE-2026-42784)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Uninformative error message on --import failure [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-176906)

* Return NotTrusted importing non-allowed keys [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-176907)

* [FTBFS] Update bindgen for LLVM 22 compatibility [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-176908)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
